metadata.title: Dataset of Cybersecurity & AI-Misuse Incidents in Indonesia
metadata.methodology: Insiden dikompilasi dari peristiwa yang dilaporkan publik dan disitasi secara individual (media nasional & internasional, vendor keamanan, vpnMentor, CISSReC, OJK/BSSN, pernyataan resmi pemerintah). Setiap rekaman membawa sitasi sumbernya sendiri, peringkat keyakinan (confidence), dan record_type. Field kualifikasi_peristiwa, objek_hukum, dan nexus_kausalitas merupakan ANALISIS doktrinal penulis yang dilandaskan pada fakta yang dilaporkan, bukan klaim sumber.
metadata.data_integrity_statement: Dataset ini HANYA memuat insiden nyata yang masing-masing bersumber. Tidak ada rekaman sintetis, hasil pembangkitan acak, atau ekstrapolasi. Angka yang berasal dari listing pelaku ancaman atau sumber tunggal ditandai pada field verification_note dan confidence tiap rekaman. File ini menggantikan pipeline lama generate_100_incidents.py + rename_incidents.py yang memfabrikasi 95 dari 100 rekaman; pipeline tersebut telah dipensiunkan.
metadata.limitations: Dataset bersifat purposive (bukan sampel acak/lengkap) dan condong pada insiden berskala besar yang terliput media; insiden kecil/tak dilaporkan kurang terwakili. Sebagian skala (mis. BPJS 279 juta, NPWP 6 juta) berasal dari klaim pelaku/penjual dan belum diaudit independen. Dua rekaman bertipe pattern_aggregate (statistik penipuan AI OJK; deepfake pemilu 2024) merepresentasikan fenomena agregat, bukan satu insiden diskret.
metadata.sources_note: Lihat field 'sources' pada tiap insiden untuk sitasi lengkap (outlet, judul, URL, tanggal).

incidents.title_en: Brain Cipher ransomware cripples Temporary National Data Center (PDNS 2)
incidents.peristiwa_hukum_kronologi: On 20 June 2024, PDNS 2 in Surabaya was encrypted by the Brain Cipher ransomware (a derivative variant of LockBit 3.0) after Windows Defender was disabled, paralyzing 282 services across 210+ central and regional agencies, including immigration autogates and education registration. The attackers demanded a USD 8 million ransom, which the government refused; on 3 July 2024 the group released the decryption key for free.
incidents.kualifikasi_peristiwa: Illegal access to and/or extortion of an electronic system (Article 30 in conjunction with Article 46 and Article 27B of the UU ITE / Electronic Information and Transactions Law), together with alleged negligence in fulfilling personal data protection obligations (UU 27/2022 on PDP / Personal Data Protection Law).

pemetaan_fakta_hukum.subjek_pelaku: The Brain Cipher group (a derivative variant of LockBit 3.0).
pemetaan_fakta_hukum.subjek_korban: The state and members of the public who use public services (airport immigration, education registration, licensing).
pemetaan_fakta_hukum.subjek_pse: The Temporary National Data Center (PDNS) 2 in Surabaya, under Kominfo, operated by Telkomsigma, with BSSN oversight.
pemetaan_fakta_hukum.objek_hukum: The availability and integrity of the Electronic System and the confidentiality of personal data.
pemetaan_fakta_hukum.akibat_hukum: Massive nationwide disruption of public services, the exposure of the absence of backups (backup/DRC), and a national data governance crisis.
pemetaan_fakta_hukum.nexus_kausalitas: The absence of data backups and Disaster Recovery mitigation — not the attack alone — was the fatal precondition that allowed a single encryption event to paralyze hundreds of agencies.

incidents.title_en: BKN civil-servant (ASN) data allegedly leaked and sold (~4.7M)
incidents.peristiwa_hukum_kronologi: On 10 August 2024, the BreachForums user 'TopiAx' claimed to have stolen 4,759,218 BKN records (NIP, NIK, name, place/date of birth, position, agency, address, contact, education) and offered them for ~USD 10,000. CISSReC verified a sample of 128 Aceh civil servants (ASN) as authentic; BKN stated it was investigating together with BSSN and Kominfo.

pemetaan_fakta_hukum.akibat_hukum: Exposure of sensitive employment data of millions of state employees and added pressure to establish a data protection authority.
pemetaan_fakta_hukum.nexus_kausalitas: Weak access controls/encryption on the personnel database enabled exfiltration; the volume figure comes from the seller's claim, which was partially verified.

incidents.title_en: Elementary teacher arrested for intruding into BKN database (6.3 GB)
incidents.peristiwa_hukum_kronologi: In September 2024, police arrested a 25-year-old honorary elementary school teacher in Banyuwangi who had obtained BKN employee login credentials from BreachForums, downloaded ~6.3 GB of sample data, uploaded it to Pastebin, and then sold it for ~USD 8,000 on BreachForums and Telegram. The perpetrator was self-taught with no formal IT education.

pemetaan_fakta_hukum.akibat_hukum: Theft and sale of personnel data; the arrest and prosecution of the perpetrator.
pemetaan_fakta_hukum.nexus_kausalitas: The abuse of legitimate credentials (credential abuse) — rather than exploitation of a technical vulnerability — was the primary vector, indicating weak access management.

incidents.title_en: KPU voter roll (DPT) leak of ~204 million records ('Jimbo')
incidents.peristiwa_hukum_kronologi: Around 27-28 November 2023, 'Jimbo' offered 204,807,203 unique voter records from the voter roll (DPT) (NIK, family card number/KK, ID card/KTP, name, place/date of birth, marital status, address, polling station/TPS) for ~USD 74,000, with 500,000 sample records as proof. Resecurity later linked the compromise to info-stealer malware on KPU endpoints.

pemetaan_fakta_hukum.akibat_hukum: Exposure of the PII of nearly all voters ahead of the February 2024 election and concerns over the integrity of the electoral database.
pemetaan_fakta_hukum.nexus_kausalitas: An info-stealer-infected operator endpoint served as the entry point; KPU did not officially confirm the origin of the data.

incidents.title_en: President Jokowi's vaccine certificate exposed via PeduliLindungi feature
incidents.peristiwa_hukum_kronologi: In early September 2021, President Joko Widodo's vaccine certificate was accessed and circulated online after users exploited the vaccination-check feature in the PeduliLindungi app. The Health Minister stated that access to officials' data had been blocked and security improved; Kominfo argued that the NIK/vaccination data might have originated from other government sources.

incidents.title_en: WannaCry ransomware hits Dharmais & Harapan Kita hospitals (Jakarta)
incidents.peristiwa_hukum_kronologi: In mid-May 2017, during the global WannaCry outbreak, Dharmais Hospital and Harapan Kita Hospital in Jakarta were hit by ransomware that encrypted Windows files via an SMB vulnerability. The director of Dharmais reported that nearly all computers were affected; medical records and billing systems were locked with a ransom of ~USD 300 in Bitcoin. Operations recovered via backups, and Kominfo stated that no medical records were leaked.

pemetaan_fakta_hukum.objek_hukum: The availability and integrity of the Electronic System and the confidentiality of personal data.
pemetaan_fakta_hukum.akibat_hukum: Temporary disruption of IT systems and access to medical records; recovery via backups with no confirmed data leak.
pemetaan_fakta_hukum.nexus_kausalitas: Systems were unpatched against the SMB vulnerability (EternalBlue); the existence of backups was the differentiator for recovery.

incidents.title_en: OJK-documented wave of AI voice-cloning & deepfake financial fraud
incidents.peristiwa_hukum_kronologi: OJK reported that the two most common AI fraud methods in Indonesia are voice cloning (imitating the voice of a relative/colleague/official to request an urgent transfer) and deepfake video, including bypassing biometric liveness/eKYC checks. Losses reached Rp7.8 trillion between November 2024 and November 2025, with 70,000+ AI-enabled fraud reports as of August 2025.
incidents.kualifikasi_peristiwa: AI-based synthetic identity fraud / voice cloning and circumvention of authentication (Article 28 and Article 35 of the UU ITE / Electronic Information and Transactions Law in conjunction with Article 378 of the Criminal Code / KUHP).

pemetaan_fakta_hukum.objek_hukum: The victims' assets and the reliability of authentication (eKYC/voice biometrics).
pemetaan_fakta_hukum.akibat_hukum: Hundreds of millions of US dollars in consumer losses; OJK and Komdigi issued AI governance guidance and strengthened biometric protocols.
pemetaan_fakta_hukum.nexus_kausalitas: A pattern/aggregate marking the maturation of voice cloning and synthetic eKYC abuse, together with regulatory gaps.
